hero.headline: Command an institutional algorithmic desk built for futures alpha.
hero.subheadline: Sub-millisecond copy routing, an AI Sentiment Analytics Engine, and risk-gated execution — paper-validate first, then arm live capital with confidence.

faq.question: Is the 7-day institutional trial really free?
faq.answer: Yes. Trialing status unlocks the Pro feature set so you can vault exchanges in paper mode, run the scanner, and validate Telegram ops alerts before billing.

faq.question: Do you place live orders by default?
faq.answer: No. Paper trading is the default. Live copy routing is gated by configuration and requires validated API keys with withdrawals disabled.

faq.question: Which venues are supported?
faq.answer: Binance, Bybit, KuCoin, and OKX via CCXT, with tier limits on how many accounts you can vault to the institutional desk.

faq.question: How does sub-millisecond copy routing size orders?
faq.answer: Follower order size scales by equity ratio versus the master account — a $100 follower mirrors 1% of a $10,000 master notional.

faq.question: What if I don’t have a Telegram bot token yet?
faq.answer: Alerts run in mock mode and append to a local outbox file so you can verify message content without leaving the machine.
